tools.name: quote_data_result
tools.description: Free pre-payment quote for one ResultRail public-data result. Returns price, paid endpoint, success contract, and whether the buyer's max price covers the result.

tools.name: enrich_domain_result
tools.description: Fetch a public domain/homepage and return one source-attributed result pack: company/title/description, industry guess, technographic signals, useful paths, confidence, sources, and receipt hash.

tools.name: extract_url_result
tools.description: Fetch one public URL and return title, description, headings, text preview, links, confidence, source URL, and receipt hash. Designed for pay-per-success agent extraction.
